test_case_name: Accept Cookie Consent on Exclusive Product Page After Navigation from Parent

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Acconsento' button to accept cookies on the child page
And then check that the cookie consent banner is dismissed on the Exclusive product page

test_case_name: Access Guest Login on Exclusive Product Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Accesso clienti' button on the child page to open the guest login form
And then check that the guest login form is displayed on the Exclusive product page

test_case_name: Perform Guest Login on Exclusive Product Page (Desktop) After Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Accesso clienti' button on the child page to open the guest login form
Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field on the guest login form (desktop)
Type $password into the 'Password' input field on the guest login form (desktop)
Click 'ENTRA' button to submit the guest login form (desktop)
And then check that the user is logged in or receives a login response on the Exclusive product page

test_case_name: Search for Information on Exclusive Product Page (Desktop) After Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Search' button (desktop) on the child page to open the search input
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field (desktop)
Click the search submit button (desktop) to perform the search
And then check that the search results are displayed on the Exclusive product page (desktop)

test_case_name: Search for Information on Exclusive Product Page (Mobile) After Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Menu' button (mobile) on the child page to open the mobile menu
Type $name into the 'Cerca' input field (mobile)
Click the search submit button (mobile) to perform the search
And then check that the search results are displayed on the Exclusive product page (mobile)

test_case_name: Apply and Remove Filters in Sticky Bar on Exclusive Product Page (Mobile) After Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' link on the main navigation menu of the parent page
Click 'Tutti i prodotti' button in the sticky bar (mobile) on the child page
Click the 'SOLUZIONE DOMANI' checkbox to select the filter
Click 'APPLICA FILTRI' button to apply the selected filter
And then check that the product list is filtered by 'SOLUZIONE DOMANI' on the Exclusive product page (mobile)
